Current promotion

This November we include 4 inverter air conditioners (one 18,000 BTU and three 12,000 BTU units). Valid through November 30, 2026.

Description

Adara is a gated community of 75 homes with 3 and 4 bedrooms in Temozón Norte, just minutes from northern Mérida’s best shopping centers, the Country Club, schools and universities.

There are eight models, one and two stories, from 186 to 307 m² of construction. Every home comes with a pool, solar panels, covered carport, kitchen cabinetry, tempered-glass shower panels, marble stairs, a decorative stone wall and a water pressure system. The community has a 24/7 security booth, electric fence, social terrace with grill area, gym, padel court, pet park and playground.

There are homes ready to move in and others with deliveries through March 2027. We’ll help you compare models and lots so you choose the one that fits you best.
